Internal helper: the counts a 100% stacked bar is drawn from

Source: R/plot.R
dot-jst_plot_stacked_counts.Rd

Ruling R68's two data-first routes. A SET OF ITEMS, one bar per item: the items must share their categories – labelled items the same value-label set, an unlabelled item's values among it, and items of one kind (the Session 414 lean) – or the call stops with the by = line. Each bar's whole is that item's valid answers. A VARIABLE WITHIN GROUPS, one bar per group of by =, the whole each group's cases with a value on the variable. A variable of more than 20 values stops, as it stops jcrosstab(), unless categorical = names it.

Usage

.jst_plot_stacked_counts(
  data,
  items,
  by = NULL,
  as_numbers = character(0),
  asserted = character(0),
  call = NULL
)

Arguments

data

The frame after the pipeline.

items

Character; the variables stacked.

by

NULL, or the grouping variable as a factor, one value per row of data.

as_numbers

Character; the items the call asserts as numeric.

asserted

Character; the items categorical = names.

call

The call as typed, for the line the 20-value stop offers.

Value

A list: cells (bar, cat, n, as factors and a count), bars and cats (their names in order) and ns (each bar's whole).
